{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Richard Steven Elman''' (born 21 March 1945) is an American [[mathematician]] at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]], known for his work in [[algebra]]. He received his Ph.D. at the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in 1972, under the supervision of [[Tsit Yuen Lam]].<ref>[http://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=22811 The Mathematics Genealogy Project - Richard Elman], retrieved 2013-07-08.</ref>

He is a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2013-07-08.</ref> Among his collaborators are Nikita Karpenko and [[Alexander Merkurjev]].
